## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (it becomes the squash commit + changelog entry)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally (Biome, tsc, frontend tests, Ruff, pytest)
- [ ] New user-facing strings exist in both `messages/en.json` and `messages/ar.json`
- [ ] Tests added or updated for new behaviour
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or `.env` files committed
- [ ] Docs updated (README / CONTRIBUTING / architecture) where relevant
